name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 7 No 54

clue.text: Celebrity eating at home shows hunger
Cereal encrusted with sugar, with mouldy decoration, as it were!
I get excited, and flare up
Bakers’ plates, initially giant sieves
Coins making little difference
Mad friar, grotesque
Group living together converse
Race or races bedevilled by eastern sorceress
Heraldic device, shell-like, with name in bearing reversed
Model of industry joins border county
Great man associated with one — er — element
Part of weekend alone in the Lake District
Fashionable and mostly quiet, drop in
Coach for trippers to old city racing out of control
A giddy man, I read while wool-gathering
Don’t pass a strong-box having an anti-accident mechanism
Raving fellow, Pll get a phone cut off
Child grabbing former princess’s plate of ham and salad?
See 7
Trickery producing a bubbling couscous with a dash of HP
Like a muffin, say, when laid up?
Sauce, taking live beast round hospital
A short time on the heather is amusing
Merry Andrew to become delirious
Forces’ head wants English officer material
Drunkard rings about tax of earlier years
